evals.prompt: Design REST endpoints for managing projects that contain tasks
evals.expected_output: Plural noun resource paths nested under the parent (/projects, /projects/:id/tasks), correct verbs and status codes (201 on create, 204 on delete, 400/404 for errors), and pagination on list endpoints.

evals.prompt: When should we use PUT versus PATCH in our API?
evals.expected_output: PUT replaces the whole resource and is idempotent; PATCH applies a partial update. Explains that repeated identical PUTs produce the same state, while PATCH sends only changed fields.

evals.prompt: Design a GraphQL schema for a blog with authors and posts
evals.expected_output: Author and Post types with relations, queries for fetching posts with filtering, mutations for creating and updating, and a note about solving N+1 with data loaders or batched resolvers.
